# In-place depth-2 with a non-commutative outer op: dst[i] -= a[i]*alpha keeps
# the destination as the left operand of Sub.

exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func SubScaledFloat32s(dst, a []float32, alpha float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] -= a[i] * alpha
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

func SubScaledFloat32s(dst, a []float32, alpha float32) {
	_vcAFloat32s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(alpha)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(a[_i:])
		_v2, _ := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(dst[_i:])
		_v2.Sub(_v1.Mul(_vcAFloat32s0)).StorePart(dst[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	dst := []float32{100, 200, 300, 400, 500}
	a := []float32{1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
	test.SubScaledFloat32s(dst, a, 2.0)
	fmt.Println(dst[0], dst[1], dst[2], dst[3], dst[4])
}
-- testmain/output --
98 196 294 392 490
